## Головний вхідний фасад

Джерело: `01_Architectural_Zones/01_Main_Entry_Facade/00_Brief.md`.

```text
Create a photorealistic evening exterior visualization of the front entrance facade of the real one-story house from the uploaded photos. Preserve the real roof form, low horizontal proportions, windows, dark front door, carport connection on the left, and overall geometry.

Style: organic modern / warm natural minimalism. The facade is warm greige mineral plaster, not pure white. Roof, gutters and metal elements are dark graphite-brown matte. The entrance door is dark graphite/black.

Main design:
- Add a vertical natural wood portal around the front door from the entrance platform up to the roof overhang.
- Use warm natural wood, matte finish, not orange glossy varnish.
- Redesign the entrance stairs as a wide calm architectural podium, approximately 9.1 m wide, finished in warm grey stone, microcement or outdoor porcelain.
- Add gravel strips and natural planting on both sides of the stairs: ornamental grasses, lavender/sage, low shrubs.

Lighting:
- All light is warm white, maximum 2700K.
- Add one soft linear warm LED/neon line under the front roof overhang only above the main house wall.
- This front facade line must stop at the left edge of the house wall and must not continue across the full carport roof.
- Add two warm up/down wall lights on the wooden entrance portal.
- Add hidden warm LED lighting under the stair nosings across the full width of the entrance steps.
- Add small low-glare garden lights hidden in the planting.
- No cold white light, no RGB, no bright LED roof outline, no high-tech look, no hotel-like overlighting.

Mood: calm blue hour, warm natural light, modern Ukrainian countryside house, expensive but restrained, natural materials, soft shadows.
```

## Навіс

```text
Create a photorealistic exterior visualization based on the uploaded photos of the real house. Preserve the real geometry, roof shape, column rhythm, wall positions, windows, and proportions. The scene is the long covered carport / canopy area along the side of a one-story house.

Style: organic modern, warm natural minimalism, not high-tech, not classic. The canopy is 3.54 m wide and 11.85 m long. The house wall is warm greige mineral plaster. The roof, gutters, beams, and columns are dark graphite-brown matte. The underside of the canopy has a warm natural wood ceiling with visible clean boards and beams.

Show the view from under the canopy, human eye level, looking along the length of the covered space. Use corrected perspective, no fisheye distortion, realistic 28-35mm architectural lens. The space should feel calm, clean, practical, and premium but not luxury-showroom.

Lighting:
- all light is warm white, maximum 2700K;
- add 10 discreet recessed or surface downlights under the wooden canopy ceiling: two longitudinal rows of five fixtures;
- add one soft linear warm LED/neon line along the inner side of the outer beam / column line, using the Figma LED length of about 12.65 m;
- do not continue this line around the entire roof perimeter;
- add small low-glare lights on the wooden columns, shining downward;
- the main front facade neon line stops at the house wall line and does not continue across the full carport roof;
- beams are lit indirectly by the linear light and downlights, not outlined with LED strips;
- lighting should be dimmed, soft, layered, and glare-free.

Materials and landscape:
- replace dirt floor with large-format warm grey concrete pavers or brushed concrete suitable for car parking;
- add a gravel strip along the outer edge with ornamental grasses, lavender/sage, and low natural planting;
- hide bicycles, tools, children toys, and technical clutter behind a vertical wooden slatted screen near the far end of the canopy;
- include a clean white car under the canopy, but do not let it dominate the composition;
- add a small accessible technical cabinet for power supplies/controllers, visually integrated into the wooden screen.

Mood:
Evening / blue hour visualization with warm 2700K lighting. Natural, calm, modern Ukrainian countryside house. No RGB, no cold white light, no shiny chrome, no marble, no luxury hotel look, no overbright LED strips, no futuristic high-tech style.
```

## Тераса

Джерело: `01_Architectural_Zones/03_Terrace/00_Brief.md`.

```text
Create a photorealistic evening exterior visualization based on the uploaded real photos of the terrace side of a one-story countryside house. Preserve the real house. Do not redesign it.

Critical constraints:
- Do not change the color, shape, size, material, or position of existing windows and doors.
- Window and door frames must remain exactly like in the reference photos.
- Do not add new windows, doors, facade openings, or glass walls.
- Preserve the real geometry, roof slope, roof thickness, terrace niche, columns, beam rhythm, wall positions, and the long canopy connection on the right.
- Do not repaint the house into a different color scheme for the rendering.

Style: organic modern / warm natural minimalism. The terrace should become a warm wooden outdoor room, not a technical unfinished porch.

Architecture and materials:
- The existing green wall behind the terrace must be fully clad with natural wood slats or vertical wood planks.
- The roof/ceiling above the terrace must be completely closed from below with a finished warm natural wood soffit ceiling.
- The terrace ceiling must look fully completed: flat clean soffit surface, neat joints, no exposed rafters, no visible raw roof construction, no OSB, no unfinished boards, no open technical gaps.
- Keep the dark graphite-brown beams and columns, but make them clean, matte, and integrated.
- Main surrounding facade is warm greige mineral plaster.
- The terrace floor is finished with warm grey large-format outdoor porcelain, brushed concrete, or stone.
- The terrace plinth / side concrete base is finished in dark graphite stone, microcement, or matching outdoor cladding.

Levels and terrace step:
- Raise the finished terrace zero level by one comfortable step from the garden level.
- Create one wide calm architectural step / podium across the full 6.30 m width of the terrace.
- The step should feel like a broad podium integrated into the landscape, not a small separate concrete stair.
- Add one hidden warm LED line under the front nosing of this full-width step.

Lighting:
- All lighting is warm white, maximum 2700K.
- Add 4 clearly visible but discreet recessed downlights in the finished wooden soffit above the terrace, arranged in two rows of two between beams.
- Add a soft hidden warm LED line along the front edge / inner cornice of the finished soffit, only in the terrace zone, not around the whole roof.
- Add hidden 2700K LED lighting under the single full-width terrace step.
- Add gentle warm light washing the wooden wall, very soft and low-glare.
- The lighting must visibly illuminate the soffit ceiling, the wooden wall, the terrace floor, and the step. Do not leave the terrace dark while only the garden lights glow.
- Treat the light mineral side facade beside the terrace as a separate calm plane: optionally add a very soft warm line under the roof overhang or subtle low garden washers, but do not make it a bright LED frame.
- Add small garden lights hidden in gravel and ornamental grasses in front of the terrace.
- No cold white light, no RGB, no bright LED perimeter around the entire roof, no LED strips on every beam.

Landscape and mood:
- Use natural gravel strips, ornamental grasses, lavender/sage, low shrubs, and a clean transition from terrace to garden.
- Remove visual clutter, laundry, temporary wires, toys, tools, ladders, and random pots.
- Evening / blue hour mood, calm, natural, modern, warm, Ukrainian countryside house.

Negative prompt:
Do not change window or door colors. Do not make the frames black if they are not black in the reference. Do not change facade openings. Do not leave the terrace roof unfinished. Do not show exposed rafters, raw boards, OSB, or open structural roof elements. Do not replace the required terrace lighting with only landscape garden lights. Do not create a decorative LED outline around the whole roof.
```
